```{ojs}
API_BASE = window.SEQUOIA_API_BASE || ""

apiJson = async path => {
  const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`)

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(
      `API indisponible (${path}) : HTTP ${response.status}`
    )
  }

  return await response.json()
}

dashboardPayload = await apiJson("/api/dashboard/publications")
labsPayload = await apiJson("/api/dashboard/labs")

publications = dashboardPayload.items ?? []
publicationLabsCluster = labsPayload.items ?? []
```

```{ojs}
yearOptions = [
  "Toutes",
  ...Array.from(
    new Set(
      publications
        .map(d => d.year)
        .filter(d => d != null)
        .map(d => String(d))
    )
  ).sort()
]

pillarOptions = [
  "Tous",
  ...Array.from(
    new Set(
      publications
        .map(d => d.pillar)
        .filter(d => d && d.trim() !== "")
    )
  ).sort()
]

axisOptions = [
  "Tous",
  ...Array.from(
    new Set(
      publications
        .map(d => d.axis)
        .filter(
          d =>
            d &&
            d.trim() !== "" &&
            d !== "No class"
        )
    )
  ).sort()
]

labOptions = [
  "Tous",
  ...Array.from(
    new Set(
      publicationLabsCluster
        .map(d => d.lab)
        .filter(d => d && d.trim() !== "")
    )
  ).sort()
]
```

```{ojs}
html`
<section class="hero-banner publications-hero">
  <div>
    <div class="hero-kicker">CLUSTER SEQUOIA</div>
    <h1>Publications</h1>
    <p>Rechercher, filtrer et consulter les publications scientifiques du corpus.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="hero-meta">
    <strong>${publications.length.toLocaleString("fr-FR")}</strong>
    <span>publications disponibles</span>
  </div>
</section>
`
```

## Rechercher dans le corpus

:::

::: {.publication-filter-grid}

::: {.filter-card .search-filter}
**RECHERCHE**

```{ojs}
viewof searchText = Inputs.text({
  placeholder: "Titre ou auteur…"
})
```
:::

::: {.filter-card}
**ANNÉE**

```{ojs}
viewof selectedYear = Inputs.select(yearOptions, {value: "Toutes"})
```
:::

::: {.filter-card}
**PILIER**

```{ojs}
viewof selectedPillar = Inputs.select(pillarOptions, {value: "Tous"})
```
:::

::: {.filter-card}
**AXE SCIENTIFIQUE**

```{ojs}
viewof selectedAxis = Inputs.select(axisOptions, {value: "Tous"})
```
:::

::: {.filter-card}
**LABORATOIRE**

```{ojs}
viewof selectedLab = Inputs.select(labOptions, {value: "Tous"})
```
:::

:::

```{ojs}
publicationKey = d => d.publication_id ?? d.halId_s

selectedLabPublicationIds = new Set(
  selectedLab === "Tous"
    ? publications.map(publicationKey)
    : publicationLabsCluster
        .filter(d => d.lab === selectedLab)
        .map(d => d.publication_id ?? d.halId_s)
)

filteredPublications = publications.filter(d => {
  const query =
    String(searchText || "")
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()

  const title =
    String(d.title || "")
      .toLowerCase()

  const authors =
    String(d.authors || "")
      .toLowerCase()

  const searchMatch =
    query === "" ||
    title.includes(query) ||
    authors.includes(query)

  const yearMatch =
    selectedYear === "Toutes" ||
    String(d.year) === selectedYear

  const pillarMatch =
    selectedPillar === "Tous" ||
    d.pillar === selectedPillar

  const axisMatch =
    selectedAxis === "Tous" ||
    d.axis === selectedAxis

  const labMatch =
    selectedLab === "Tous" ||
    selectedLabPublicationIds.has(publicationKey(d))

  return (
    searchMatch &&
    yearMatch &&
    pillarMatch &&
    axisMatch &&
    labMatch
  )
})

displayedPublications = filteredPublications
  .slice()
  .sort(
    (a, b) =>
      Number(b.year || 0) - Number(a.year || 0) ||
      String(a.title || "").localeCompare(String(b.title || ""))
  )

publicationsWithCitations =
  filteredPublications.filter(
    d =>
      d.citations != null &&
      d.citations !== "" &&
      !Number.isNaN(Number(d.citations))
  ).length

totalCitations =
  filteredPublications.reduce(
    (sum, d) =>
      sum +
      (
        d.citations == null ||
        d.citations === "" ||
        Number.isNaN(Number(d.citations))
          ? 0
          : Number(d.citations)
      ),
    0
  )
```

```{ojs}
html`
<div class="result-toolbar">

  <div class="result-stat">
    <strong>${filteredPublications.length.toLocaleString("fr-FR")}</strong>
    <span>publications trouvées</span>
  </div>

  <div class="result-stat">
    <strong>${publicationsWithCitations.toLocaleString("fr-FR")}</strong>
    <span>avec données de citation</span>
  </div>

  <div class="result-stat">
    <strong>${totalCitations.toLocaleString("fr-FR")}</strong>
    <span>citations cumulées</span>
  </div>

</div>
`
```

### Résultats

Triés par année décroissante. Cliquez sur les en-têtes du tableau pour explorer les colonnes.

:::

```{ojs}
Inputs.table(
  displayedPublications.map(d => ({
    Année: d.publication_date ? d.publication_date.split("-").reverse().join("/") : String(d.year ?? ""),
    Titre: d.title || "",
    Auteurs: d.authors || "",
    Type: d.doc_type || "",
    Pilier: d.pillar || "",
    Axe: d.axis || "",
    Statut:
      d.classification_status === "to_review"
        ? "À confirmer"
        : "Validé",
    Citations:
      d.citations == null ||
      d.citations === ""
        ? ""
        : Number(d.citations),
    HAL: d.url || "",
    DOI: d.doi || ""
  })),
  {
    rows: 12,

    columns: [
      "Année",
      "Titre",
      "Auteurs",
      "Type",
      "Pilier",
      "Axe",
      "Statut",
      "Citations",
      "HAL",
      "DOI"
    ],

    width: {
      Année: 100,
      Titre: 340,
      Auteurs: 230,
      Type: 95,
      Pilier: 145,
      Axe: 195,
      Statut: 105,
      Citations: 85,
      HAL: 80,
      DOI: 80
    },

    format: {
      Citations: value =>
        value === "" || value == null
          ? "—"
          : value.toLocaleString("fr-FR"),

      HAL: value =>
        value
          ? html`<a
              href=${value}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
            >HAL</a>`
          : "",

      DOI: value => {
        if (!value) return ""

        const doiUrl =
          String(value).startsWith("http")
            ? value
            : `https://doi.org/${value}`

        return html`<a
          href=${doiUrl}
          target="_blank"
          rel="noopener noreferrer"
        >DOI</a>`
      }
    }
  }
)
```
